claim: A run executes only under the exact instruction set it pinned — a single edited byte, an added file, a removed file, or two files swapping contents all fail closed before the run starts.

steps.label: the instruction set is byte-for-byte the pinned one
one word changed in one instruction file
steps.note: Drift is caught before the run starts, not noticed in the audit after.

steps.label: an extra instruction file the pinned run never saw
steps.note: Re-hashing only known files would accept an injected one silently.

steps.label: the same two files, contents swapped between them
steps.note: The multiset of hashes is identical. Only the name-to-hash binding moved, and that is what the manifest binds.
